mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals an active monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the average 20d return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals tightening labor market conditions, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 60% of cases when UNRATE < 4.5%, or the mean return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction starts above 1.5 million units signals strong household demand and rising inflationary pressures, which triggers a hawkish monetary policy response and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1500.0, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 110.0 indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which signals an impending economic slowdown and reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60d returns in more than 60% of cases when INDPRO < 110.0, or the mean return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both residential construction starts and real personal consumption expenditures signals strong aggregate demand, which accelerates inflation and triggers a preemptive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST > 1500.0 and RSAFS > 360000.0, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in interaction regression).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the CPI inflation rate above 2.0% combined with a stable federal funds rate signals persistent inflation, which increases the probability of future rate hikes and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 201.5 and FEDFUNDS <= 5.5%, or the interaction term in a regression model has a non-negative coefficient (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment above 136,000 thousand combined with a declining unemployment rate signals a labor market that is both expanding and tightening, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 136000 and UNRATE < 4.6%, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An ongoing expansion in real GDP growth above 2.0% per quarter, combined with stable inflation, signals a strong and sustainable economic expansion that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 60d returns in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 > 2.0% (annualized), or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
